correctness.rationale: Signed cubical boundary SNF gives 149 ones and one 2, so \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z^6\oplus\mathbb Z/2\). Triangle loops prove canonical \(p_*\) onto graph \(H_1\). Integral graph cycles canonically equal exterior-square augmentation lattice. Exact mod-two coordinate computation produces 105/260/150 cells, 7- and 6-dimensional mod-two spaces, projection and actions of two generators of \(S_5\). The 42-variable section system has coefficient and augmented rank 41, and both sections are explicitly checked. The torsion kernel injects mod2, so sections lift uniquely and equivariance lifts.

originality.rationale: Three published research index queries on K5 two-point braid first homology, vertex symmetries, and integral modules returned no matching \(K_5\)-equivariant-section claim. The full text of Ko–Park 2011, especially Theorem 3.16 and Sections 2–3, establishes only the underlying abstract group, not an equivariant section count. Closest indexed \(S_5\) configuration claim is on the distinct Petersen graph; an indexed complete-graph \(S_5\) claim concerns sink configurations, not collision-free unordered configurations. This is evidence against direct coverage, not a proof of uniqueness.

value.rationale: \(K_5\) is the minimal five-vertex nonplanar complete graph and the first canonical example whose unordered two-strand braid first homology has nontrivial 2-torsion. An exact integral \(S_5\)-equivariant splitting question, which rank and torsion do not settle and can differ on closely related graph families, is structurally motivated. Determining that the natural sequence splits and admits exactly two sections is a precise complete classification of the symmetry-compatible lifts, not a restatement of the known Betti number.
